WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- A tooltip is measured one moment after it is drawn. When the Persian text is taller than the English it replaced, or a word is wider than the box, the tooltip is made as big as its text needs, so the last line is not outside the frame. Not in a fight and not on action bar tooltips.
- Firearms and Guns no longer share one Persian name.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Names of report 541. The auction house windows are switched off for now. Two-handed is written with a space. One Persian word for one English term across about 1000 rows. The taint watcher for the blocked action buttons.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
